title: RNA editing landscape and regulatory mechanisms in myelodysplastic syndromes
description: This project profiles RNA sequencing data from bone marrow and peripheral blood samples collected from patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), including low-risk MDS, high-risk MDS, and azacitidine-treated patients. The study investigates RNA editing patterns and their associations with disease risk, gene expression, immune-related pathways, and epitranscriptomic regulation. The resulting data will support identification of RNA editing events and regulatory factors associated with MDS progression, including candidate biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
